geometry_schema.provenance: Describes the original procedural geometry in src/world.js (PR #307 baseline 006b5e8) against public/reference/approved-yard.png and docs/design/tokens.json; validated by tests/voxelSchema.test.mjs and scripts/capture-art.mjs; ART-06 crane lift cycle (#352) validated by tests/craneMotion.test.mjs and scripts/capture-crane.mjs; ART-05 vehicle rigs (#351) validated by tests/vehicleRigs.test.mjs, scripts/measure-rigs.mjs and scripts/capture-rigs.mjs; ART-07 yard terrain/scenery (#353) validated by tests/yardScenery.test.mjs and scripts/capture-terrain.mjs
geometry_schema.footprint_contract: Logical footprints mirror src/content.js footprintOf() (#370, main e8240a87); crane 2x3, others 1x1. Geometry fields are authored local space; world group scaled by base w/d at the footprint center.

vehicle_rigs.source: src/world.js createTruck/truckIdentity/stepTruck/syncTruckCargo/createForklift/forkliftLift/createDrone/droneHover/activeCycleAnchor/createWorker/rigShell/applyRigLod (pure pose functions shared by runtime update() and tests) + src/voxelSchema.js RIGS/RIG_LOD/rigLodTier/validateRig
vehicle_rigs.provenance: All geometry original, authored in code (shared unit BoxGeometry + 8-segment cylinders, shared MATERIALS pool, flat shading); no external/downloaded models; blockout glTF entries remain reference-only per import_policy

authority.truck: simulation.js freight ledger (reserve/pickup/arrive); crates only while v.cargo onboard, count max(1,min(3,ceil(amount/5))), tinted RESOURCE_BY_ID; empty tray shows nothing
authority.forklift: none — decorative yard crew (#274); fork lift is a pure function of nearest real truck distance to the depot bay post; never carries a load mesh
authority.drone: none — decorative yard crew (#274); hovers over a building only while its real cycle timer advanced frame-over-frame, else parked at DRONE_PAD
authority.worker: none — decorative yard crew (#274); static posed 1.7-unit scale reference, arms posed not animated

vehicle_rigs.identities: truckIdentity(v) = ((v.id % 3) + 3) % 3 preserves original per-id liveries: id%3=1 AMBER STAKE-BED (orange, 4 wheels, beacon), id%3=2 TEAL TIPPER (body, 6 wheels, ram), id%3=0 RUST FLATBED (rust, 4 wheels, headboard slats)
vehicle_rigs.motion: wheelSpin = travelled world distance / 0.3 (real sim deltas * CELL); steer wrap-aware route heading clamp +/-0.45 with decay; suspension bob speed-gated (0 when parked); forkliftLift 0.75 at <=2 units, 0 at >=6; droneHover bob sin(t*1.3)*0.18 rotor t*22

lod.tier2: single-box proxy in rig livery, cargo culled, visibility toggles only

vehicle_rigs.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion parks wheel/steer/bob/beacon/forks/rotors; distance still accrues, truck positions still follow sim, economic timing untouched

yard_scenery.provenance: All geometry original, authored in code (shared unit BoxGeometry + 8-segment cylinders, shared MATERIALS pool, flat shading, seeded LCG); no external/downloaded models or textures; graded against public/reference/approved-yard.png and docs/design/tokens.json (every world hex already in the MATERIALS pool — tokens unchanged)
yard_scenery.authority: none — decorative yard scenery (#274); no pick volumes, no build-site occupancy, no route blocking; picking stays cell-based (screenToCell), scenery is never raycast

placement_contract.interior: volumetric props (wreck/barrel) and rubble (scrapPile/outcrop) ONLY on surveyed rock cells outside starter footprints and bays — every covered cell rejects checkSite with TERRAIN; grading keeps Manhattan neighbors of roads/starter as pad, so props can never touch a route
placement_contract.exterior: containers/sheds/silos/pipeRacks/floodlights/gatePosts/fence/boulders on a SQUARE belt beyond the parcel edge (|coord| > 42; boulder perpendicular offset >= 43.5 with conservative rotated AABB radius <= 1.247) — BOUNDS/UNSURVEYED for building, immune to any legal road network
placement_contract.decals: flush instanced quads top <= 0.06 (road top 0.185), never on road cells; bench tints, pad dust, maintenance alleys + tire tracks, bay chevrons (intentional on bays), oil stains, gate stripes
placement_contract.dynamic: sceneryConflicts(plan,g) hides props/rubble whose cells are covered by g.roads, footprintCells or bayCells; applied ONLY in rebuild(), never per-frame; zero-scale instance matrices with byte-exact restore from rubbleBase; fresh save hides nothing; seed change rebuilds scenery and preserves crew

yard_scenery.rendering: rubble + decals are exactly 2 InstancedMeshes (white-base MeshStandardMaterial + setColorAt, frustumCulled=false, decals castShadow=false); props are static seeded groups named scenery:<kind> with userData.decorative/authority/sceneryKind; earth slab castShadow=false
yard_scenery.build_ghost: drawGhost derives each cell's top surface from the SAME plan data that builds meshes (surfaceTopFor(plan,x,z,hidden) over decals/rubble/props, plus live roads roadTop and machine pick heights via ghostTop); ghostLift(top,thickness)=top+thickness/2+.02 keeps the thin decal above raised dressing; slab opacity .7 (valid #7ed4b3 / invalid #ee8263), bay opacity .3; no hardcoded heights; occupancy-hidden scenery stops lifting the ghost
yard_scenery.camera_invariants: applyCamera/stampCamera byte-identical to main (sha256-16 f3afa5479a66b97e / 691b3c0a3480e97b, hash-guarded in tests/yardScenery.test.mjs and scripts/capture-terrain.mjs)
yard_scenery.evidence: tests/yardScenery.test.mjs (19 tests incl. buried-ghost regressions, full suite 258/258 on rebased main 8bdb7223 baseline 239) + scripts/capture-terrain.mjs -> docs/evidence/353-art-07/ (PASS_NUMERIC_ONLY, source_sha cccd502b9af87e120f1ad80f8f5d2d692a06f151, 16 PNGs desktop 1440x900 + emulated phone 390x844 dpr2: fresh-save stills, build-ghost TERRAIN negative + valid pad positive with region-chroma proofs, decoded PNG stats, real validator verdict stamps)
